name: Minimum-Section Deletion from a Rank-Three Hamming Ball
definition: Let $M$ be the rank-three Hamming ball about $00000$, and fix two coordinates to $11$. Its four-word section $S$ is the rank-one Hamming ball on the other three coordinates. Delete these four words.
properties: The residual class has 22 words. The fixed section is contained in all other sections on the two-coordinate block. The deletion theorem constructs a rank-three maximum parent on seven coordinates with 64 words, and exactly two auxiliaries are necessary among rank-three parents.
